visual_logic.composition: A tight, high-angle 'work' shot. The camera is focused on the ground where the large, black, serrated Australovenator tooth is still partially embedded in the silty Tahora clay.
visual_logic.action: Paleontologist_2 (short black hair, green sun hat) is using a fine-tipped dental pick in one hand and a small puffer bulb in the other to blow away fine sand from the serrated edge of the 'slicer' tooth. Her expression is one of intense, joyful focus.
visual_logic.details: A small 'field kit' is open next to her, containing a vial of consolidant (fossil glue) and a soft brush. You can see the lagoon in the soft-focus background.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the tactile interaction between the tool and the fossil.
